instruction: I want to set my current time zone to Australia/Sydney. Can you help me?

command: import pyautogui; import time; pyautogui.click({SCREEN_WIDTH_HALF}, {SCREEN_HEIGHT_HALF}); time.sleep(0.5);

metadata.explanation: Task requires setting timezone to Australia/Sydney. Evaluator checks timedatectl output for correct timezone string. Verified by checking timedatectl output format: line with 'Time zone:' contains timezone pattern.

llm_judge_reasons: Evaluator correctly uses 'timedatectl status' command to extract timezone information - the standard Ubuntu method for timezone verification
Metric logic correctly parses timedatectl output format, extracting timezone name from 'Time zone: Australia/Sydney (AEDT, +1100)' pattern
Comparison logic is semantically correct - exact string match on timezone name 'Australia/Sydney' aligns with instruction requirement
Complete coverage - instruction only requires timezone setting, evaluator checks exactly that requirement
Expected value 'Australia/Sydney' is semantically correct for the instruction
No postconfig needed - timezone setting persists after configuration
Edge case handling adequate - returns 0.0 if 'Time zone:' line not found in output
